7.8.2 TCP/IP Stack state handling
The internal states are shown in Figure 7.2. Details are described in the following requirements. An overview of the internal states is described in [SWS_TCPIP_00073]. Initial TCPIP_STATE_STARTUP entry / EthSM_TcpIpModeIndication(TCPIP_STATE_STARTUP) TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE entry / EthSM_TcpIpModeIndication(TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE) TCPIP_STATE_SHUTDOWN entry / EthSM_TcpIpModeIndication(TCPIP_STATE_SHUTDOWN) TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE entry / EthSM_TcpIpModeIndication(TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE) TCPIP_STATE_ONHOLD entry / EthSM_TcpIpModeIndication(TCPIP_STATE_ONHOLD) TcpIp_RequestComMode(TCPIP_STATE_ONHOLD) /Up_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg (TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ONHOLD) deactivate the communication within TcpIp module [Ip priority reassignment] TcpIp_RequestComMode(TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE) /Up_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg(TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_UNASSIGNED) deactivate the communication within the TcpIp module request releasing the resources [ressources are released] TcpIp_RequestComMode (TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE) /reactivate the communication within the TcpIp module Up_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg (TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ASSIGNED) TcpIp_RequestComMode (TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE) /enable IP assignment TcpIp_RequestComMode (TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE) /Up_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg (TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_UNASSIGNED) request releasing the resources TcpIp_Init() [Ip priority reassignment] [Ip is assigned] /Up_LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg (TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ASSIGNED) TcpIp_RequestComMode(TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE) /immediately release the resources do not inform EthSM  upon entering state TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE start assigning the resources after TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE was entered and proceed to TCPIP_STATE_STARTUP TcpIp_RequestComMode (TCPIP_STATE_OFFLINE) /abort IP assignment Figure 7.2: Ctrl state machine of the TcpIp
